description: This file implements a minimal Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style server for basic arithmetic operations (addition and subtraction). It includes functions to perform these operations and a main server loop that reads JSON requests from standard input, processes them, and writes JSON responses to standard output. The file also exposes the addition and subtraction functions for reuse.

methods.name: Number add(a: Union[Number, str], b: Union[Number, str])
methods.description: Return the arithmetic sum of a and b, accepting integers, floats, or numeric strings.

methods.name: Number subtract(a: Union[Number, str], b: Union[Number, str])
methods.description: Return the arithmetic difference a - b, accepting integers, floats, or numeric strings.

methods.name: None serve_stdio()
methods.description: Main server loop that reads JSON requests from stdin, processes them, and writes responses to stdout.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _make_error_response(req_id: Optional[Union[str, int]], code: str, message: str)

ctags.name: _make_error_response
ctags.pattern: /^def _make_error_response(req_id: Optional[Union[str, int]], code: str, message: str) -> Dict[str/
ctags.signature: (req_id: Optional[Union[str, int]], code: str, message: str)

ctags.name: _make_success_response
ctags.pattern: /^def _make_success_response(req_id: Optional[Union[str, int]], result: Number) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
